p: To morrow about this time shall: The godly are always assured of God's help in their necessity, but the times and hours are only revealed by God's Spirit.
leaned answered the man of God: To whom the king gave the charge and oversight of things as in 2Ki 7:17.
windows in heaven: He mocked at the prophets words saying, that if God rained down corn from heaven, yet this could not come to pass.
eat thereof: Your infidelity will be punished in this when you see this miracle, and yet not partake of it.
entering in of the gate: For it was commanded in the law that they should dwell apart, and not among their brethren, Le 13:46.
noise of chariots: Thus God needs no great preparation to destroy the wicked. Though they are many he can scatter them with a small noise, or shaking of a leaf.
fled for their life: The wicked need no greater enemy than their own conscience to pursue them.
I will now shew you what: He mistrusted the prophets words, and therefore could believe nothing, as they who are more prudent than godly always cast more doubt than is needed.
multitude of Israel that are left: There are no more left, but they, or the rest are consumed by the famine, as the rest of the people.
according to the word of the: Which he spoke by the mouth of Elisha, 2Ki 7:1.
trode upon him in the gate: As the people pressed out of the gate to run to the Syrian's tents, where they had heard meat and great spoil was left.
